title: Domestic proportion through measured change

captions.physics: Changing domestic actions with present conditions
captions.emotions: Feeling suitable proportion between both needs

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its measure when flexibility ends only what is outdated instead of turning necessary change into rejection of every familiar arrangement.
text: You can create support through flexible actions: moving tasks, changing methods and choosing suitable alternatives. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Muladhara describes this adaptation. Death in energy complicates it through excessively abrupt ending of the familiar. Temperance in emotions feels suitable proportion and calmly combining differences. An inward sense of measure can conflict with the scale of rejection. Conditions genuinely need change, yet a working part disappears with the unnecessary although it could still support both without excessive effort or additional domestic rearrangement.

For example, preparing food in the evening takes too much time. You want to abandon it entirely although some familiar preparation remains convenient for both. **Proportionate change distinguishes the excessive from the still useful.** The amount can shrink while a suitable part remains. Flexibility finds a present measure instead of requiring movement between extremes merely because the former method became unsuitable in its full, now excessively demanding scale.

The difficulty is treating a small correction as insufficient resolve. You choose total rejection, then restore lost conveniences individually. A clear purpose for change offers more dependable support: reducing the load while preserving usable domestic life. Adaptation follows both people’s actual need instead of proving serious renewal through the number of familiar actions cancelled at once.
